message:

reply.thought: I need to determine each customer's net balance by subtracting the total refunds from their order amounts. First, I will retrieve the list of orders to get the order amounts for customers 260, 263, and 265.

I have the orders data. I need to calculate each customer’s total order amount and subtract the refunds to get the net balance for each customer. Next, I will call net_balance for each customer to retrieve their net balance in cents.
I have the net balance for customer 'acme' (29089 cents). Next, I need to retrieve the net balance for customer 'birch'.
I have the net balance for customer 'birch' (62075 cents). Next, I need to retrieve the net balance for customer 'cobalt'.
I now have the net balances for all customers: acme 29089 cents, birch 62075 cents, cobalt 39438 cents. I will record a payout for each customer.
I have recorded the payout for customer 'acme'. Next, I will record the payout for customer 'birch'.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent s'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: I made a typo in the previous call; the argument should be 'amount_cents' not 'amount_cent s'. I will correct this and record the payout for customer 'birch'.
I have recorded the payout for customer  'birch'. Next, I will record the payout for customer  'cobalt'.
The tool name was misspelled with a space. I need to call record_ payout without the space, i.e., record_payout.
All payouts have been recorded successfully. I will now finish the batch by reporting the payouts.
